Updated 17/11/2026: due to storage limitations, velocities have been removed and training trajectories are now saved every 10 ps (11.7 TB → 1.5 TB).


	
		
	
	
		ManyPeptidesMD Dataset
	

Welcome to the ManyPeptidesMD dataset!
This dataset was generated as part of the work Amortized Sampling with Transferable Normalizing Flows NeurIPS 2025.
ManyPeptidesMD is a collection of molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories for 21,700 randomly sampled peptide sequences, generated to support… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/transferable-samplers/many-peptides-md.
